name: cortico-world-coo-screen
description: Cortico World: press a hotkey and hand the current screen to Coo, one frame at a time

zh.description: 按一下热键,把当前这一屏交给 Coo 看:它先说清这是什么,再告诉你下一步怎么做。抓屏在一个只依赖标准库的 Python 侧车里做,不装 Pillow、不常驻录屏,只在按键那一刻拍一帧。

en.description: Press a hotkey and Coo looks at your screen: first what this is, then what to do next. Capturing happens in a stdlib-only Python sidecar, with no Pillow and no always-on recording; one frame per keypress.
